prompt:
Isometric technical illustration, orthographic camera from one corner looking down 30 degrees, no perspective. Hairline even-weight linework on every edge. Flat four-tone shading by face direction, top faces lightest. Warm paper background for day scenes, dark navy-charcoal for night. Only parts that show live data are brass, and each carries fine engraved scale marks; every other material follows the scene's architectural tradition. Exactly one part highlighted in vivid orange: the place where value is moving right now. Engineering-drawing precision with dense, purposeful detail. Calm, legible and serious, like a plate in an engineering atlas.

A full-screen isometric map of the harbour island in daylight, edge to edge with no page around it, filling a widescreen display. In each of the four corners, a small caption in the manner of an engraved atlas plate, set on the paper ground as fine blank lines of type, with a tiny path of scale marks in one corner. A slim search field floats near the top centre. A narrow paper drawer is open along the right edge, holding a pinned note card and a receipt, beside the selected machine and not covering it. Everything else is the map: districts, compounds, stalls, piers and figures, dense and varied. The selected machine's pour is the orange part.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create one complete standalone reference candidate, not a sheet, montage or collage. Daylight on warm paper. Widescreen 16:9 composition, one image of the screen itself with no surrounding device. Compose the harbour map around an open central canal, with dense glass-and-riveted-steel compounds and a market hall. Keep the selected machine near the right drawer but fully visible, with ample map around it. Every parallel construction edge stays parallel; equally sized elements keep equal image size at every depth. Ground joints use a quiet lighter line tone than structures. Keep four distinct face tones. Brass is muted gold, confined to scaled instruments. Orange forms exactly one connected active pour. Caption and drawer content consists of abstract blank horizontal type strokes, no readable words or digits. Do not add titles, candidate labels, browser chrome or surrounding device.

Strict projection and paint discipline: use parallel axonometric projection with no focal-length camera. Every edge along the same construction axis shares exactly one angle; there is no taper, foreshortening with distance or size falloff. Render large clean flat color regions with hard boundaries, no water texture, paper grain, metallic shine or modeled illumination. This reinforces the source orthographic and flat-four-tone requirements.

Avoid: perspective, vanishing points, depth of field, photographic lighting, soft gradients, bloom, neon, holograms, casino imagery, coins and dollar signs, numbers, arrows, callouts, motion lines, watermarks, real brand logos, faces on robots, identical islands, generic steampunk clutter, decorative gears, brass on decorative parts, more than one orange highlight.
